en: Colorized vintage aerial view of a riverside town with mountains in the background. In the foreground are orderly streets lined with trees and low multi‑story buildings with red and gray roofs. Near the river stands a distinct white church with a tall, narrow bell tower. A bridge crosses the river to the opposite bank, where more buildings and rail tracks are visible. On the right margin there is a printed caption and handwritten cursive message, typical of early 20th‑century postcards.
